policy: C161 always contributes. Pocketsphinx loose VAD, 30 ms frames, onset following 450 ms unvoiced. Use the last onset already available at word proposal; recent means within the pre-existing 1.32-second address window. Compare parent or positive trigger verifier only after recent onsets, and the trigger verifier near an onset with peak-negative verifier otherwise. Same 360 ms and cooldown.
